name: log

tools.description:
Reads frame and memory stats. Fails for unknown stat names.
Returns: Stat name -> value.

names.description: Stats to read: fps, frame_ms, game_ms, render_ms, rhi_ms, gpu_ms, memory_mb, actors, nodes (default: fps, frame_ms, game_ms, render_ms, gpu_ms, memory_mb).

tools.name: log.get_stat

tools.description:
Pushes new lines of a log category to this session as events (type "log"), or stops doing so.
Returns: The session's subscriptions and how lines are delivered.
tools.name: log.subscribe_log_category

returnValue.description: The session's subscriptions and how lines are delivered.

subscriptions.description: Categories this session is subscribed to.

returnValue.title: RuntimeLogSubscriptions

tools.description:
Returns recent log lines, oldest first, filtered by category, verbosity and text.
Returns: The lines {seq, category, verbosity, message} and last_seq.

limit.description: Maximum lines returned (0 = project default); the newest matching lines are kept.

min_verbosity.description: Most verbose level to include: Error shows only errors (and fatal), Log includes Display and Log.

since_seq.description: Only lines after this sequence number (the last_seq of a previous call).

tools.name: log.tail_log

returnValue.description: The lines {seq, category, verbosity, message} and last_seq.

last_seq.description: Newest sequence number in the capture buffer: pass it as since_seq next time.

seq.description: Sequence number (increasing); pass the last one as since_seq to read only newer lines.

returnValue.title: RuntimeLogTail
